attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates New Hampshire state income tax per hypothetical Form NH-1040. New Hampshire uses progressive tax brackets: 3% on first $75,000, 5% on $75,000-$150,000, 7.5% above $150,000. Starting with federal AGI, applies standard deduction based on filing status, then calculates tax using progressive brackets with div/int arithmetic only.

initial_action.action_postfix: "NEW HAMPSHIRE FORM NH-1040 - State Income Tax Calculation" job.audit_trail swap addto result.agi /result.nh_agi xdef 0 /result.nh_bracket_1_tax xdef 0 /result.nh_bracket_2_tax xdef 0 /result.nh_bracket_3_tax xdef

action_details.action_comment: Calculate NH tax MFJ; Calculate NH tax with MFJ standard deduction and progressive brackets
action_details.action_postfix: " Starting Federal AGI: $" result.nh_agi cvs strconcat " (Form 1040 Line 11)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto nh_standard_deduction_mfj /result.nh_standard_deduction xdef " Standard Deduction (MFJ): $" result.nh_standard_deduction cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.nh_agi result.nh_standard_deduction f- 0 fmax /result.nh_taxable_income xdef " NH Taxable Income: $" result.nh_taxable_income cvs strconcat " (AGI - Std Deduction)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto result.nh_taxable_income nh_bracket_3_threshold f> if nh_bracket_2_threshold nh_bracket_1_rate f* /result.nh_bracket_1_tax xdef nh_bracket_3_threshold nh_bracket_2_threshold f- nh_bracket_2_rate f* /result.nh_bracket_2_tax xdef result.nh_taxable_income nh_bracket_3_threshold f- nh_bracket_3_rate f* /result.nh_bracket_3_tax xdef " Bracket 1 (3% on $0-$75,000): $" result.nh_bracket_1_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Bracket 2 (5% on $75,000-$150,000): $" result.nh_bracket_2_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Bracket 3 (7.5% above $150,000): $" result.nh_bracket_3_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto else result.nh_taxable_income nh_bracket_2_threshold f> if nh_bracket_2_threshold nh_bracket_1_rate f* /result.nh_bracket_1_tax xdef result.nh_taxable_income nh_bracket_2_threshold f- nh_bracket_2_rate f* /result.nh_bracket_2_tax xdef " Bracket 1 (3% on $0-$75,000): $" result.nh_bracket_1_tax cvs strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto " Bracket 2 (5% on $75,000-$" result.nh_taxable_income cvs strconcat "): $" strconcat result.nh_bracket_2_tax cvs strconcat strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto else result.nh_taxable_income nh_bracket_1_rate f* /result.nh_bracket_1_tax xdef " Bracket 1 (3% on $0-$" result.nh_taxable_income cvs strconcat "): $" strconcat result.nh_bracket_1_tax cvs strconcat strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto endif endif result.nh_bracket_1_tax result.nh_bracket_2_tax f+ result.nh_bracket_3_tax f+ /result.nh_tax xdef " Total NH Tax: $" result.nh_tax cvs strconcat " (Form NH-1040)" strconcat job.audit_trail swap addto
